name: Break a Few Eggs

angles.text: As a cook, you know the pressure of keeping people fed. Bringing fragile ingredients back unbroken is part of the work in any kitchen.

aliases: what is break a few eggs
faq.answer: Cook Torka needs you to bring Taillasher eggs back unbroken from the Echo Isles, so the kitchen can keep to its schedule.
faq.q: What is the quest Break a Few Eggs?

aliases: who gives break a few eggs
faq.answer: Cook Torka prepares meals throughout the day at Razor Hill in Durotar. Torka speaks bluntly and is in a hurry, relying on you to fetch Taillasher eggs from the Echo Isles without cracking them before mealtime.
faq.q: Who is the cook in Break a Few Eggs?

faq.answer: Cook Torka needs eggs for meals prepared throughout the day, from breakfast through dinner. Fresh eggs keep the kitchen's work on schedule.
faq.q: Why does the cook need eggs?

faq.answer: Eggs can break on the way back. Cook Torka needs the shells and yolks intact for the coming meal service.
faq.q: Why does the cook comment on not being clumsy?

aliases: why is it called break a few eggs
faq.answer: The title echoes the proverb about making an omelet and breaking eggs. It suits the work of carrying fragile ingredients to a busy kitchen.
faq.q: What does the title Break a Few Eggs refer to?

faq.answer: Cook Torka is busy preparing meals from breakfast through dinner. With more cooking to do, Torka has little patience for chitchat and wants to return to the stove.
faq.q: Why is the cook so impatient?

sections.body: At Razor Hill in Durotar, Cook Torka prepares meals from morning through evening. Breakfast gives way to lunch, then dinner, with little time to leave the stove for provisions. So Torka sends you to the Echo Isles for Taillasher eggs before the next meal service falls behind. Bring them back whole, and the cook can keep the kitchen working on time.
sections.title: Endless Meals

sections.body: Cook Torka has little time for praise while meals wait to be made. Eggs need a gentle touch, since a cracked shell spoils an ingredient the kitchen needs. When you bring the eggs back unbroken, Torka sends you on your way and returns to work over the fire.
sections.title: A Cook's Gratitude

summary: Cook Torka is waiting on fresh eggs from the Echo Isles before the next meal. You carry them back unbroken so the kitchen can keep to its schedule.
